title: GET /orders/v2/orders/{guid}: a malformed guid is the documented 400, an unknown guid the documented 404, both as ErrorMessage

source.note: The operation's responses: 400 for a guid that isn't well-formed, 404 when no order matches it; guid identifies which order to fetch and Toast-Restaurant-External-ID names the restaurant the order belongs to. The specification attaches no schema to either response; the ErrorMessage body shape is the example on apiResponsesAndErrors.html, and the message wording is asserted as any string because a response description is not a body.
